description: Emails the person a link to watch up to 25 listings free: once they open it, they get one short email on any day the board's record changes (status, workers' comp, bonds, classes, expiry). CSLB contractors only. Use the person's own email, only when they asked. Before calling, show them this and get their yes: 'I agree that DouxProcess Directory may email <email> about changes to these licenses (status, workers' comp, bonds, classes, expiry). Nothing is watched until I open the link, and I can stop any time.' Set consent=true only if they agreed; clients with forms get a consent form.

consent.description: True only if the person read and agreed to the consent sentence.

slugs.description: Listing slugs (or CSLB license numbers), up to 25.
